instruction: I want to see the message pane below the message list instead of on the right side. Can you configure Thunderbird to use a vertical layout?

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Thunderbird pane layout to vertical (message pane below list). The evaluator checks if mail.pane_config.dynamic preference is set to 0 (vertical layout). Standard Thunderbird preference: 0=vertical, 1=wide. Similar complexity to original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly retrieves Thunderbird preferences file (prefs.js) using get_vm_file getter
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js and extracts mail.pane_config.dynamic preference
Expected value of 0 is semantically correct for vertical layout (0=vertical, 1=wide in Thunderbird)
Postconfig correctly closes Thunderbird window before verification to ensure preferences are flushed to disk
Complete coverage: instruction requires vertical layout, evaluator checks exactly mail.pane_config.dynamic==0
All-or-nothing scoring is appropriate for this binary configuration task
State accessibility is correct: postconfig with sleep(0.5s) ensures preference file is saved before reading

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
